summary.text: Kristina Soltys is the Republican candidate for Washington State Senate District 47 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent Claudia Kauffman.

paragraphs.text: Soltys advanced from the August 4, 2026 nonpartisan primary in second place, with 41.2 percent of the vote to Kauffman's 58.8 percent.
